n: <int> Number of items available for assignment to knapsacks.
m: <int> Number of knapsacks available to hold items.
profits: <list[int], length n> Individual profit earned when each item is placed in any knapsack.
pairwise_profits: <list[list[int]], shape [n][n]> Symmetric matrix of bonus profit earned when two items are placed together in the same knapsack, with zero diagonal.
weights: <list[int], length n> Weight consumed by each item when placed in a knapsack.
capacities: <list[int], length m> Maximum total weight each knapsack can hold.
